description: Horaires théoriques et temps-réel du réseau Tarbes / Lourdes - TLP mobilités (GTFS / GTFS-RT) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by TLP Mobilités. Theoretical timetables in GTFS format and real-time timetables in GTFS-RT format of the TLP Mobility network circulating in Tarbes and Lourdes. Official timetables are available on the [TLP Mobilités] website ( With Zenbus you can also monitor the position of the buses in real time:. Coverage: TLP Mobilités. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical and real-time timetables of the Tarbes / Lourdes network - TLP mobilities (GTFS / GTFS-RT)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is TLP Mobilités. The listing shows 2026-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
